package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidCurriculum     = errors.New("invalid curriculum")
	ErrCurriculumUnavailable = errors.New("curriculum unavailable")
)

type LearningPathItemStatus string

const (
	LearningPathItemPlanned         LearningPathItemStatus = "PLANNED"
	LearningPathItemReady           LearningPathItemStatus = "READY"
	LearningPathItemInProgress      LearningPathItemStatus = "IN_PROGRESS"
	LearningPathItemCompleted       LearningPathItemStatus = "COMPLETED"
	LearningPathItemSkippedMastered LearningPathItemStatus = "SKIPPED_MASTERED"
)

type LearningPathItem struct {
	ReferenceType string                 `json:"reference_type"`
	ReferenceID   string                 `json:"reference_id"`
	Position      int                    `json:"position"`
	Status        LearningPathItemStatus `json:"status"`
	Targets       []LearningTargetRef    `json:"targets"`
	ReasonCode    string                 `json:"reason_code"`
}

type StudentLearningPath struct {
	ID                   string             `json:"id"`
	StudentID            string             `json:"student_id"`
	CourseID             string             `json:"course_id"`
	GoalCode             string             `json:"goal_code"`
	CurriculumRevision   string             `json:"curriculum_revision"`
	CourseFingerprint    string             `json:"course_fingerprint"`
	PolicyVersion        string             `json:"policy_version"`
	PlannerPolicyVersion string             `json:"planner_policy_version"`
	ReasonCode           string             `json:"reason_code"`
	ReasonSummary        string             `json:"reason_summary"`
	Status               string             `json:"status"`
	IsPrimary            bool               `json:"is_primary"`
	IsSelected           bool               `json:"is_selected"`
	Version              int64              `json:"version"`
	Items                []LearningPathItem `json:"items"`
	CreatedAt            time.Time          `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt            time.Time          `json:"updated_at"`
}

type DiagnosticSnapshotItem struct {
	Target       LearningTargetRef  `json:"target"`
	State        TargetMasteryState `json:"state"`
	MasteryScore float64            `json:"mastery_score"`
	Confidence   float64            `json:"confidence"`
}

type StudentDiagnosticSnapshot struct {
	ID                 string                   `json:"id"`
	StudentID          string                   `json:"student_id"`
	AssessmentID       string                   `json:"assessment_id"`
	CurriculumRevision string                   `json:"curriculum_revision"`
	PolicyVersion      string                   `json:"policy_version"`
	Items              []DiagnosticSnapshotItem `json:"items"`
	CompletedAt        time.Time                `json:"completed_at"`
}

type StudentLearningSession struct {
	ID                       string     `json:"id"`
	StudentID                string     `json:"student_id"`
	Goal                     string     `json:"goal"`
	CourseID                 string     `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	LessonID                 string     `json:"lesson_id,omitempty"`
	TaskID                   string     `json:"task_id,omitempty"`
	AnalyticsSessionID       string     `json:"analytics_session_id,omitempty"`
	ActiveLearningSeconds    int        `json:"active_learning_seconds"`
	LessonCount              int        `json:"lesson_count"`
	TaskCount                int        `json:"task_count"`
	QuestionCount            int        `json:"question_count"`
	SelectedExplanationCount int        `json:"selected_explanation_count"`
	CodeRunCount             int        `json:"code_run_count"`
	FailureCount             int        `json:"failure_count"`
	PassedTestCount          int        `json:"passed_test_count"`
	HintCount                int        `json:"hint_count"`
	TeacherInterventionCount int        `json:"teacher_intervention_count"`
	StuckSignalCount         int        `json:"stuck_signal_count"`
	Version                  int64      `json:"version"`
	SchemaVersion            string     `json:"schema_version"`
	StartedAt                time.Time  `json:"started_at"`
	EndedAt                  *time.Time `json:"ended_at,omitempty"`
	UpdatedAt                time.Time  `json:"updated_at"`
}

func NormalizeStudentLearningPath(input StudentLearningPath, studentID string) (StudentLearningPath, error) {
	input.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseID)
	input.GoalCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.GoalCode))
	input.CurriculumRevision = strings.TrimSpace(input.CurriculumRevision)
	input.CourseFingerprint = strings.TrimSpace(input.CourseFingerprint)
	if input.CourseFingerprint == "" {
		input.CourseFingerprint = input.CurriculumRevision
	}
	if input.CurriculumRevision == "" {
		input.CurriculumRevision = input.CourseFingerprint
	}
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	input.PlannerPolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PlannerPolicyVersion)
	input.ReasonCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.ReasonCode))
	input.ReasonSummary = strings.TrimSpace(input.ReasonSummary)
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC()
	input.UpdatedAt = input.UpdatedAt.UTC()
	if !validUUID(input.ID) || input.StudentID != studentID || !validUUID(input.CourseID) ||
		!validValue(input.GoalCode, 64) || !validValue(input.CurriculumRevision, 128) || input.CourseFingerprint != input.CurriculumRevision ||
		input.PolicyVersion != "student-learning-path-v1" || !validValue(input.PlannerPolicyVersion, 64) || !validValue(input.ReasonCode, 64) ||
		!validValue(input.ReasonSummary, 2000) || input.Version < 1 || input.CreatedAt.IsZero() ||
		input.UpdatedAt.Before(input.CreatedAt) || len(input.Items) < 1 || len(input.Items) > 50 {
		return StudentLearningPath{}, errors.New("invalid student learning path")
	}
	for index := range input.Items {
		item := &input.Items[index]
		item.ReferenceType = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(item.ReferenceType))
		item.ReferenceID = strings.TrimSpace(item.ReferenceID)
		item.ReasonCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(item.ReasonCode))
		targets, err := normalizeLearningTargetRefs(item.Targets, 500)
		if err != nil || item.ReferenceType != "lesson" || !validUUID(item.ReferenceID) ||
			item.Position != index || !validPathStatus(item.Status) || !validValue(item.ReasonCode, 64) {
			return StudentLearningPath{}, errors.New("invalid student learning path item")
		}
		item.Targets = targets
	}
	return input, nil
}

func validPathStatus(status LearningPathItemStatus) bool {
	switch status {
	case LearningPathItemPlanned, LearningPathItemReady, LearningPathItemInProgress,
		LearningPathItemCompleted, LearningPathItemSkippedMastered:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func NormalizeStudentDiagnosticSnapshot(input StudentDiagnosticSnapshot, studentID string) (StudentDiagnosticSnapshot, error) {
	input.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.AssessmentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.AssessmentID)
	input.CurriculumRevision = strings.TrimSpace(input.CurriculumRevision)
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	input.CompletedAt = input.CompletedAt.UTC()
	if !validUUID(input.ID) || input.StudentID != studentID || !validUUID(input.AssessmentID) ||
		!validValue(input.CurriculumRevision, 128) || input.PolicyVersion != "student-diagnostic-snapshot-v1" ||
		input.CompletedAt.IsZero() || len(input.Items) < 1 || len(input.Items) > 100 {
		return StudentDiagnosticSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid diagnostic snapshot")
	}
	for index := range input.Items {
		item := &input.Items[index]
		targets, err := normalizeLearningTargetRefs([]LearningTargetRef{item.Target}, 1)
		if err != nil || !validTargetMasteryState(item.State) || item.MasteryScore < 0 || item.MasteryScore > 1 ||
			item.Confidence < 0 || item.Confidence > 1 {
			return StudentDiagnosticSnapshot{}, errors.New("invalid diagnostic item")
		}
		item.Target = targets[0]
	}
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeStudentLearningSessions(input []StudentLearningSession, studentID string) ([]StudentLearningSession, error) {
	if len(input) > 5 {
		return nil, errors.New("too many learning sessions")
	}
	for index := range input {
		session := &input[index]
		session.ID = strings.TrimSpace(session.ID)
		session.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(session.StudentID)
		session.Goal = strings.TrimSpace(session.Goal)
		session.CourseID = strings.TrimSpace(session.CourseID)
		session.LessonID = strings.TrimSpace(session.LessonID)
		session.TaskID = strings.TrimSpace(session.TaskID)
		session.AnalyticsSessionID = strings.TrimSpace(session.AnalyticsSessionID)
		session.SchemaVersion = strings.TrimSpace(session.SchemaVersion)
		session.StartedAt = session.StartedAt.UTC()
		session.UpdatedAt = session.UpdatedAt.UTC()
		if !validUUID(session.ID) || session.StudentID != studentID || !validValue(session.Goal, 1200) ||
			(session.CourseID != "" && !validUUID(session.CourseID)) || (session.LessonID != "" && !validUUID(session.LessonID)) ||
			(session.TaskID != "" && !validUUID(session.TaskID)) || (session.AnalyticsSessionID != "" && !validUUID(session.AnalyticsSessionID)) ||
			session.SchemaVersion != "student-learning-session-v1" || session.Version < 1 || session.StartedAt.IsZero() ||
			session.UpdatedAt.Before(session.StartedAt) || session.ActiveLearningSeconds < 0 || session.LessonCount < 0 ||
			session.TaskCount < 0 || session.QuestionCount < 0 || session.SelectedExplanationCount < 0 ||
			session.CodeRunCount < 0 || session.FailureCount < 0 || session.PassedTestCount < 0 ||
			session.HintCount < 0 || session.TeacherInterventionCount < 0 || session.StuckSignalCount < 0 {
			return nil, errors.New("invalid learning session")
		}
		if session.EndedAt != nil {
			ended := session.EndedAt.UTC()
			if ended.Before(session.StartedAt) || session.UpdatedAt.Before(ended) {
				return nil, errors.New("invalid learning session interval")
			}
			session.EndedAt = &ended
		}
	}
	return input, nil
}
